# Manower Labs — Complete Technical & Service Documentation

## 1. Overview
Manower Labs is an engineering and AI agent laboratory delivering autonomous agent swarms and tailored operational software for wholesale distributors, logistics fleets, manufacturers, and multi-location retail enterprises. The lab bridges the gap between clunky, expensive enterprise ERPs (SAP, Oracle) and generic off-the-shelf SaaS by building custom, high-speed software and autonomous AI agents that clients own 100%.

## 2. Technical Stack & Capabilities
- **Autonomous Agents & AI**: Python (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, Gemini 3 API), Multi-Agent Swarms, Background Cron Schedulers, Tool Execution Bridges.
- **Backend & Automation**: Python (Flask, FastAPI), SQLite, PostgreSQL, PyInstaller, Node.js.
- **Frontend & Interfaces**: Modern Semantic HTML5, Tailwind CSS, Lucide Icons, Vanilla JavaScript (zero bloat, instant loading).
- **Computer Vision & Hardware Integration**: Mobile camera QR barcode scanners (HTML5 MediaDevices), in-browser receipt printing, thermal printer layouts.
- **Image Processing**: Pillow/PIL automation for high-resolution 5-in-1, 3:4 aspect ratio, and vertical collages generated dynamically from raw product photography.
- **Deployment**: Local PC (localhost), LAN Wi-Fi network servers, Cloudflare Tunnels for secure external access, Vercel edge deployment for web portals.

## 3. Core Solutions Catalog

### Flagship: Autonomous AI Agents & Multi-Agent Swarms
- **Problem Solved**: High payroll costs and human fatigue coordinating repetitive cross-system tasks between WhatsApp, ERP spreadsheets, and dispatch slips.
- **Our Solution**: Autonomous teams of AI agents that coordinate 24/7 across terminals, browsers, and local databases. One agent monitors stock levels, another drafts personalized WhatsApp catalogs, and a third audits dispatch slips.

### Solution A: Custom Logistics & Lorry Receipt (LR) System
- **Problem Solved**: Manual paper bilties get lost, tracking phone calls waste hours, and warehouse drivers cannot use complex desktop apps.
- **Our Solution**: Local-first LR tracking dashboard on PC. Each printed dispatch receipt includes a high-resolution QR code. Loading staff or delivery drivers scan the QR code via their phone camera (via local Wi-Fi or secure tunnel) to instantly mark status (*Booked*, *Reached Hub*, *Out for Delivery*, *Delivered*) and snap Proof of Delivery (POD) photos directly into the PC database.

### Solution B: WhatsApp Catalog & Marketing Engine
- **Problem Solved**: Manually cropping, collaging, and sending hundreds of new product photos to retailers on WhatsApp takes 3-4 hours daily.
- **Our Solution**: Automated Python script that watches product folders, creates branded 5-in-1 multi-angle collages with price codes, produces interactive web catalog viewers, and dispatches targeted WhatsApp broadcasts in seconds.

### Solution C: Desktop Customer Auto-Lookup & Mini-ERP
- **Problem Solved**: Staff wasting time looking up old ledger registers, phone numbers, and GST details across multiple disconnected spreadsheets.
- **Our Solution**: 1-click standalone Windows desktop application (.exe) with instant auto-complete search across thousands of customer records, auto-syncing with Excel and SQLite databases.

### Solution D: Offline-First Staff Attendance
- **Problem Solved**: Biometric machines failing offline or SaaS attendance apps charging high recurring monthly fees.
- **Our Solution**: Lightweight, self-contained HTML/SQLite application that runs off a local PC or pen drive, generating ready-to-audit monthly Excel registers.

### Solution E: Bespoke Tailoring & Alteration Operations ERP
- **Problem Solved**: High error rates in custom garment manufacturing due to messy handwritten alteration chits, lost cutter instructions, and scattered customer measurement files.
- **Our Solution**: Complete local-first atelier suite. Generates ready-to-print 4-per-A4 alteration job slips with garment cut diagrams, runs a real-time mobile PWA for shop-floor master cutters over local Wi-Fi, and handles customer measurement registries and retail GST invoicing. Live demo available at https://manowerlabs.vercel.app/alteration/.

## 4. Privacy & Data Protection Guarantee
Manower Labs strictly adheres to a zero-leak data architecture:
- All client transactional records, financial figures, customer names, and databases remain 100% on the client's local infrastructure unless explicitly opted into secure cloud syncing.
- Showcase materials, live interactive demos, and portfolio previews are strictly white-labeled and use synthetic mock datasets.
